name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-artifact (reports, plans, architecture explanations, and interactive product targets), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules, and Claude output styles onto a machine, additively), and me-human (dogfood a system from a human user's perspective). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
